def edit_distance(a, b):
    # Ensure b is the shorter string to minimise memory usage
    if len(a) < len(b):
        a, b = b, a
    m, n = len(a), len(b)
    # prev holds the edit distances for the previous row of a
    prev = list(range(n + 1))
    curr = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        curr[0] = i
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            cost = 0 if a[i-1] == b[j-1] else 1
            curr[j] = min(
                prev[j] + 1,       # deletion from a
                curr[j-1] + 1,     # insertion into a
                prev[j-1] + cost   # substitution
            )
        # Move to the next row: current becomes previous, old previous is reused
        prev, curr = curr, prev
    return prev[n]
